_comment: Work queue for the Brothers. SEO loops. Written by brothers-seo-strategist; scored by `npm run seo:score` (seo/METHOD.md §5). Every volume and KD comes from a file under seo/data/ahrefs/<date>/. Items with needsClient are skipped by the publisher until the client answers.

serp.notes: #1 mit4mit top list, #2 photoshot.co.il (studio, DR 4) with a dedicated center page, local pack bereshitebara/canfi/dafnatalmon. A DR-4 studio page at #2 means a focused page is winnable.

items.notes: Part A (now): in src/data/landing.js campaign 'weddings-big-center', retarget seo.title and hero to the hiring phrasing 'צלם חתונות במרכז' (today's title is 'צילום חתונות גדולות במרכז', which matches no measured query). Put 'צלם לחתונה במרכז' in seo.description and one faq question. Keep the slug; ads point at it. Part B (waits on Yariv's venue list, scope human step due 2026-09-21): replace the shared benefits/included copy with center-specific detail (real halls and gardens shot in Gush Dan/Sharon, guest-count handling). This page is also the planned landing page for the Google Search center campaign, so copy and ad group should match.

serp.notes: Ahrefs returned no stored SERP for this keyword on 2026-09-14 (serp-צלם-סטילס-לחתונה.json is empty).

items.notes: Retitle campaign 'stills' from 'צילום סטילס לחתונה' to the searched phrasing 'צלם סטילס לחתונה'. Answer the price-intent variant without a number: an H2/faq 'כמה עולה צלם סטילס לחתונה?' answering that the price is quoted per event and naming what drives it (hours, number of photographers, albums), then linking to the price guide once it exists. Unique copy per METHOD §7; the page is ~85% shared with the others (PR #8).

keywords.keyword: כמה עולה צלם לחתונה הכי טוב

serp.notes: AI Overview first, citing midrag.co.il price page and saveadate.co.il/wedding-photographer-cost. Organic #2 midrag (DR 73), #3 urbanbridesmag (DR 54), #4 a mit4mit Facebook group post, #6 yaniveitan.co.il (studio, DR 12), #7 engaged.co.il. KD 0 across the cluster, and a DR-12 studio ranks, so it is winnable despite the aggregators on top.

items.needsClient: May a Brothers. guide discuss typical market price ranges for wedding photography in Israel, cited to a public source (e.g. midrag.co.il's price page) with the date read, while stating that Brothers. quotes per event and publishes no price? (public/llms.txt currently forbids attributing a numeric price to the business, which this respects.)
items.notes: The largest winnable cluster on the site: 800 searches/mo across 16 variants, KD 0. One post owns all of them (METHOD §8). Structure: H2 per question (כמה עולה צלם לחתונה / מה משפיע על המחיר / סטילס מול וידאו / כמה צלמים צריך / מה כלול בחבילה / איך משווים הצעות), each with a 2–3 sentence direct answer first for AI engines. Market ranges only from a cited public source; no Brothers. price. Link to /lp/video-stills/ and the homepage #finder. Every claim about what Brothers. includes comes from public/llms.txt.

serp.notes: Ahrefs returned no stored SERP on 2026-09-14 (serp-צלם-לחתונה-קטנה.json is empty).

items.notes: Cannibalization call: the blog post intimate-wedding-photography targets 'צילום חתונה קטנה / אינטימית' and the LP targets 'צילום חתונות קטנות'. Decision per METHOD §8: the LP owns the hiring phrasing 'צלם לחתונה קטנה' (retitle seo.title/hero); the post keeps the question/guide phrasing and must link to /lp/weddings-small/ in its first third. Check the post's current links before editing.

items.notes: Only build if the client confirms real venues with photos. Otherwise mark dead. Every other city modifier measured 0–10 searches/mo (Ashdod 0, Tel Aviv 0, Haifa 0–10, Jerusalem 10, Beer Sheva 10); see parkingLot.

A DR-0 studio at #4 and a DR-0 studio cited in the AI Overview mean it is reachable.

items.notes: Retitle campaign 'video' from 'צילום וידאו לחתונה - סרט חתונה קולנועי' to lead with 'צלם וידאו לחתונה'. The AI Overview cites pages that explain film vs highlight length and style; answer those in faq[] (סרט חתונה מלא מול קליפ Highlight, כמה זמן לוקח לקבל, צלם וידאו אחד או שניים) using only facts in public/llms.txt (film up to 90 minutes, highlight 3–5 minutes). Price questions go to the price guide, not here.

items.notes: Long game, low score by design. Studios reach this term through the homepage plus the local pack, not a new page. On-page: the sr-only H1 already leads with 'צילום חתונות'; add the hiring phrasing 'צלם חתונות' to the visible hero/about copy once, and make sure the GBP profile category is 'צלם חתונות' (checklist item for the GBP owner). Real movement here comes from GBP and the offPageOpportunities, not copy.
